2608.22538.title: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control
2608.22538.paper_summary: Policy-governed agents must interpret case evidence while following an authorized procedure. We present \textsc{Stage}, an executable-graph framework that confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while placing procedural control in deterministic code. At each node, the model receives task-relevant policy context and returns a typed result, while the coordinator enforces the reviewed execution contract. We evaluate \textsc{Stage} on SOP-Bench Referral Abuse, two $τ^2$-bench domains, and Smart Dispute, a proprietary banking benchmark. Compared with monolithic full-policy execution, \textsc{Stage} generally improves task success and repeated-run reliability across workflows of varying procedural complexity. The largest gains occur on the deeper Telecom and Smart Dispute workflows, where $\mathrm{Pass}^3$ increases by 7.5--55.0 and 57.2--65.7 percentage points, respectively, depending on the model. These results show that combining policy-scoped context with deterministic procedural control can improve the reliability of policy execution.
2608.22538.paper_summary_zh: 政策驅動的代理必須在遵循授權程序的同時解釋案例證據。<lb/>我們提出了 \textsc{Stage}，一個可執行圖框架，它將模型判斷限制在政策範疇的節點，同時將程序控制放在確定性代碼中。<lb/>在每個節點，模型接收與任務相關的政策上下文並返回類型化結果，而協調者則強制執行審核過的執行合同。<lb/>我們在 SOP-Bench Referral Abuse、兩個 $τ^2$-bench 領域和 Smart Dispute（一個專有的銀行基準）上評估了 \textsc{Stage}。<lb/>與單一的全政策執行相比，\textsc{Stage} 通常在不同程序複雜性的工作流程中提高了任務成功率和重複運行的可靠性。<lb/>最大的增益發生在更深的 Telecom 和 Smart Dispute 工作流程中，$\mathrm{Pass}^3$ 分別增加了 7.5--55.0 和 57.2--65.7 個百分點，具體取決於模型。<lb/>這些結果顯示，將政策範疇的上下文與確定性的程序控制相結合可以提高政策執行的可靠性。
